_meta.description: AGG_WELFORD as the crosstab cell on revenue by region × treatment, with row, column and grand margins. Each cell value is the cell mean; the full Welford state {n, n_null, mean, m2, variance, stddev, origin, shifted_mean} sits in components.crosstab.cell_components[r][c] at the same (r, c) coordinates. row_key_components / column_key_components carry the GROUP_CATEGORY axis components, row_margin_components / column_margin_components the margin states recomputed from raw records, and grand_total_components the all-records state. The reference example for crosstab component indexing (skills: response-components, crosstab-guide).
